source: Bitte senden Sie uns ein Preisangebot. Die Mindestbestellmenge beträgt fünfhundert Stück, und die Lieferzeit beträgt vierzehn Kalendertage ab Bestellung.
Le paiement se fera par crédit documentaire, et non par garantie bancaire. L’acompte de vingt pour cent n’est pas inclus dans le prix unitaire.
La orden de compra no es una solicitud de compra. La entrega parcial requiere la aprobación del comprador.
Il fornitore deve presentare la fattura e la polizza di carico prima del pagamento. La garanzia contrattuale è di dodici mesi.
O preço não inclui IVA. Precisamos de um acordo-quadro e de uma especificação técnica antes de emitir a encomenda.
Nie akceptujemy niezgodności. Odbiór towaru nastąpi po sprawdzeniu dokumentu dostawy. Kara umowna za opóźnienie dostawy wynosi jeden procent tygodniowo.
Beoordeel de totale eigendomskosten, niet alleen de eenheidsprijs. De leverancier moet een veiligheidsvoorraad aanhouden.
Solicităm o garanție de bună execuție de cinci la sută. Subcontractantul trebuie să respecte acordul privind nivelul serviciilor.
Nejprve dokončíme kvalifikaci dodavatelů. Zadavatel požaduje cenovou nabídku a nesouhlasí s platbou předem.
Гарантийное удержание составляет пять процентов. Запрос котировок RFQ не заменяет запрос предложений RFP. Не раскрывайте LC без контекста.
The delivery lead time is fourteen calendar days from the purchase order, not the delivery date.
Payment is by documentary letter of credit, not by bank guarantee.
The minimum order quantity is five hundred units. The unit price excludes VAT.
Please send the invoice and the bill of lading. A documentary letter of credit is required, not a credit card.
The framework agreement does not permit partial delivery without the buyer’s approval.
The supplier must provide performance security of five percent. Do not assume it is a bank guarantee.
The retention money is five percent. Compare the total cost of ownership, not just the purchase price.
The subcontractor must comply with the service level agreement and maintain safety stock.
The goods fail the technical specification. We cannot complete acceptance before inspection.
Delivery is DDP Berlin, Incoterms 2020. Do not change it to DAP. The price excludes VAT.
Поставка DDP Берлин, Incoterms 2020. Цена не включает НДС. Оплата через четырнадцать дней после приёмки товара.
Die Lieferzeit beträgt vierzehn Kalendertage ab Bestellung. Die Zahlung erfolgt per Dokumentenakkreditiv, nicht per Bankgarantie.
